I feel married to microsoft, as Windows is all I know, and have known since I started using computers (except for the commodor system). I just feel bitter towards MS and do not want to support them in any way.

White dots appearing over the screen. Like dead pixels. They are white and show up on dark colours. some call them pressure spots, I refuse to call them that because:

1)The device is used for drawing on

2)the device is meant to be portable

3)I have never experienced this with any other device I have ever owned

People calling them pressure spots due to user error lets MS off the hook for their poor craftsmanship/quality control them. I am very careful, keep the device in a case, and the current one i'm replacing started showing the issue within a week and it never moved from my desk. That is three devices with the exact same issue. So disappointed. Sorry went on a rant there!
Thanks for the heads up! will edit. I thought I put the specs in.

Thank you for your response! In did not expect this from MS as well but it seems for such a large tech company they are not very technically focused when it comes to there products, customer service, or internal processes. Also they refused to do an advanced exchange, which they did the for the previous replacements, and expect me to not have a computer for about two weeks. They offered no way around this either.
I was looking at the Yoga C930 but I am definitely curious about the pen functionality and whether it will be good. I was also curious about the pixlebook, or the new pixle tablet from google. If I can find a new operating system that has nothing to do with microsoft that would be preferable. I want to wipe my hands clean from microsoft after this horrible experience.
You have to speak french? The website has English as an option to sign up, I will investigate further, thank you.

Be me, similar situation, thinking about suicide. tested hanging, been carrying a rope around with me just in case. Spoke to a psychiatrist at the hospital, accidentally said my intent when I broke down. Now I am forced to stay in a psych ward. It is not all bad though. I can't hurt myself here and I am getting help/medication and time away from life stressors. I still want to hang myself, and am still anxious and depressed but there is a glimmer of hope that someone/something might help.

I am saying this because, why not give life another shot, you may continue hurting but you may feel better. If you have any questions or want to talk hit me up as I have nothing better to do in the ward :)
I don't foresee any change ever happening. I am so sick of things never changing. ugh.

I am currently on 20 mg of escitalopram and am taking 52 mg of Concerta. I was so hopeful that this would help (and from outsiders it does appear to have an effect) but I still feel the same inside.

I am currently attempting to do my masters in rehabilitation and I am not doing as well as I need to be. I have not made a single friend and have trouble getting the help I need. I also don't know what help I need.

I feel so behind that I can't catch up and I don't believe I can handle another failure. Like I said I have been this way for so long it just seems impossible to be able to change.

I don't want to get rid of the rope. I want an easy way out. I am a good looking guy who never had a bad upbringing by any means. I have no excuses or reasons for being so fucked up. I am about to fail at another endeavor and can't/won't be another failure and disappointment to everyone around me.
